sentences.en: WOMAN: For the second in our series about locally-run businesses, we meet Simon Winridge, co-founder of the hugely-successful Winridge Forest Railway Park.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 在我们关于本地经营企业的系列报道第二期中，我们采访了大获成功的温里奇森林铁路公园的联合创始人西蒙·温里奇。

sentences.en: Welcome, Simon.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，西蒙。

sentences.en: Now, perhaps you can begin by telling a us a little bit about how it all started.
sentences.zh: 那么，或许你可以先简单讲一讲这一切是如何开始的。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, during the 1970s, my wife, Liz and I had just acquired 80 acres of sheep-farming land, and we decided to settle down and have children.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，20世纪70年代，我和妻子莉兹刚买下80英亩用于养羊的农田，当时我们决定安顿下来、养育孩子。

sentences.en: Pretty soon we had a a daughter, Sarah, and a son, Duncan.
sentences.zh: 很快，我们有了一个女儿莎拉和一个儿子邓肯。

sentences.en: The place was wonderful for the kids: they particularly loved trains and gradually built up an enormous network of miniature railway track.
sentences.zh: 这个地方对孩子们来说非常棒：他们尤其喜爱火车，并逐渐建起了一条规模庞大的微型铁路轨道网络。

sentences.en: I began to develop larger-scale models of locomotives but we didn't think anything more of it until I went on a trip to a theme park near Birmingham and decided we could do a much better job!
sentences.zh: 我开始制作更大比例的机车模型，但当时并未多想，直到我去伯明翰附近的一家主题公园参观后，才意识到我们完全可以做得更好！

sentences.en: So we set up a small one ourselves based on the miniature railway and we opened to the public for just a month that year. 1984 - in July - our driest month - because our children said they didn't want our quests to have a miserable, wet visit.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们以这条微型铁路为基础，自己建起了一座小型公园，并于当年7月——1984年我们最干燥的月份——向公众开放一个月，因为孩子们说，他们不希望我们的游客经历一场糟糕又湿冷的参观。

sentences.en: I dealt with Park business and Liz carried on with the farm work.
sentences.zh: 我负责公园的业务运营，而莉兹则继续从事农场工作。

sentences.en: It soon became clear that we were onto a winner.
sentences.zh: 很快我们就意识到，这个项目大获成功。

sentences.en: We began to extend the railway track and lay it among more interesting landscape by planting trees, which in turn attracted more wildlife, and by making cuttings through the rock.
sentences.zh: 我们开始延伸铁路轨道，并将其铺设在更具趣味性的景观之中：栽种树木（这反过来又吸引了更多野生动物），以及开凿穿山岩层的路堑。

sentences.en: Nowadays, we're open all year round and we're pleased to say that Winridge is one of the most popular visitor attractions in the area - with 50,000 visitors a year - a million and a half people have been through our doors since we opened.
sentences.zh: 如今，我们全年开放，而且很高兴地告诉大家，温里奇已成为本地区最受欢迎的旅游景点之一——每年接待游客5万人次，自开园以来累计接待游客已达150万人次。

sentences.en: All these visitors mean we have had to expand our operation and it's now a truly family concern.
sentences.zh: 如此众多的游客意味着我们必须扩大运营规模，如今这真正成为一项全家参与的事业。

sentences.en: I'm near to retirement age so Lonly concern myself with looking after the mechanical side of things - keeping the trains going.
sentences.zh: 我已临近退休年龄，因此目前只负责机械方面的事务——确保火车正常运行。

sentences.en: Liz now devotes all her energies to recruiting and supporting the large squadron of workers, which keep the place running smoothly.
sentences.zh: 莉兹现在则全身心投入员工招聘与支持工作，这支庞大的员工队伍保障着园区顺畅运转。

sentences.en: We're really pleased that after some years away teaching, Sarah has now returned to the park and makes sure the visitors are kept fed and watered, which keeps her pretty busy as you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴的是，离开园区多年从事教学工作的女儿莎拉现已回归公园，负责确保游客饮食供应，正如你能想象的那样，这项工作让她相当忙碌。

sentences.en: Our son, Duncan, has been a stalwart of the park for the last ten years, taking over from me in the area of construction - and I'll say a little bit more about that in a moment - and his new wife, Judith, has also joined the team in charge of retail.
sentences.zh: 我们的儿子邓肯过去十年来一直是公园的中坚力量，已从我手中接过了建设领域的职责——稍后我会就此多谈几句；而他的新婚妻子朱迪思也已加入团队，负责零售业务。

sentences.en: That's becoming a tremendous growth area for us - a lot of people want to buy souvenirs.
sentences.zh: 零售正成为我们一个巨大的增长领域——许多游客都想购买纪念品。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So have you finished your development of the site for the moment?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，你们目前是否已完成园区的开发工作？

sentences.en: MAN: Not at all!
sentences.zh: MAN: 完全没有！

sentences.en: We're constantly looking for ways to offer more to our visitors.
sentences.zh: 我们始终在不断寻求为游客提供更多服务的方式。

sentences.en: The railway remains the central feature and there's now 1.2 kilometres of the line laid but we'd like to lay more.
sentences.zh: 铁路依然是园区的核心特色，目前轨道总长已达1.2公里，但我们还希望进一步延长。

sentences.en: Because of the geology of the area, our greatest problem is digging tunnels.
sentences.zh: 由于当地地质条件所限，我们面临的最大难题是挖掘隧道。

sentences.en: But we're gradually overcoming that.
sentences.zh: 不过我们正逐步克服这一困难。

sentences.en: We're also very pleased with new installation of the Go-Kart arena which is 120 square metres in area.
sentences.zh: 我们还非常满意新建成的卡丁车赛场，其面积达120平方米。

sentences.en: Again the problem is the geology; we had to level the mounds on the track for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 同样，地质问题仍是挑战：出于安全考虑，我们必须铲平赛道上的土丘。

sentences.en: We wanted to enable 5-12 year olds to use the go-karts.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是让5至12岁的儿童能够使用这些卡丁车。

sentences.en: And the main attraction here is the Formula 1 Kart.
sentences.zh: 此处的主要吸引力在于一级方程式卡丁车。

sentences.en: We've known fights to break out over who gets it!
sentences.zh: 我们甚至目睹过孩子们为争夺它而发生争执！

sentences.en: And then finally to our most recent development which is the landscaped ...
sentences.zh: 最后要介绍的是我们最新的开发项目——景观化……
